name: testing-best-practices
title_zh: 测试用例先问删掉哪条才心疼的 Laravel 评审
tagline_zh: 写测试最怕自我感动：覆盖率上去了，回归时照样漏。它逐条审你的用例，专挑「删了也不心疼」的冗余断言、伪隔离和慢查询。
tagline_en: Coverage lies. This skill audits each Laravel test for redundant assertions, fake isolation, and slow queries—so.
desc_en: Laravel test design and review. Use when selecting coverage, naming or structuring tests, choosing assertions or test data, isolating dependencies, testing HTTP or security boundaries, improving suite performance, or reviewing test value. Use framework guidance or search-docs for Pest and PHPUnit syntax.
why_zh: 不是语法检查器，是价值过滤器。它按「这条测试若失败，你信不信是产品坏了」来判生死。
why_en: Not a linter—a value filter. It judges each test by whether a failure would truly signal a broken product, then cites.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel 项目且已配好 Pest 或 PHPUnit；不装测试框架、不跑测试、不改代码。只输出评审意见。
limit_en: Laravel projects only, with Pest or PHPUnit configured. It doesn't install, run, or modify tests—just reviews. Pure function tests outside.
title_en: Laravel test reviewer that asks which test you'd delete
